# 0 Set up environment
```{r}
# Clean environment
rm( list = ls() )

# load libraries
library(qqman)
library(circlize)
library(VennDiagram)
library(stringr)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggplot2)
```

# 0. EOD vs LOD/VLOD threshold = 7 days (i.e. 1 weeks) - Main Analysis
```{r}
# SNP-GWAS
SNPGWAS_lt7 <- read.table("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Pyseer Results/Nextflow_pipeline_EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC/15.1.Main_analysis/SNPGWAS_Fasttree_DP_LMM.txt", sep = "\t", header=T)|> 
  filter(af>=0.05, af <0.95)|> 
  mutate(POS=as.integer(str_split(as.character(variant), "_", simplify = T)[,2]), 
         OR = exp(beta), 
         OR_pos =ifelse(OR<1, "OR<1", "OR>1"))
SNPGWAS_lt7_sig <- SNPGWAS_lt7 |>  filter(lrt.pvalue < 0.05 /nrow(SNPGWAS_lt7)) 
SNPGWAS_lt7_sig

# DB-GWAS
DBGWAS_lt7 <- read.table("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Pyseer Results/Nextflow_pipeline_EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC/15.1.Main_analysis/DBGWAS_Fasttree_DP_LMM.txt", sep = "\t", header=T)|> 
  filter(af>=0.05, af <0.95)
DBGWAS_lt7_sig <- DBGWAS_lt7 |>  filter(lrt.pvalue < 0.05 /nrow(DBGWAS_lt7)) 
DBGWAS_lt7_sig

# PanGWAS
PanGWAS_lt7 <- read.table("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Pyseer Results/Nextflow_pipeline_EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC/15.1.Main_analysis/PanGWAS_FastTree_DP_LMM.txt", sep = "\t", header=T) |> 
  filter(af >=0.05, af <0.95)
PanGWAS_lt7_sig <- PanGWAS_lt7 |> filter(lrt.pvalue < 0.05 / nrow(PanGWAS_lt7))
PanGWAS_lt7_sig

# Summarize results
final_df_lt7 <- rbind(SNPGWAS_lt7_sig |> 
  mutate(variant = str_remove(variant, "AP018935.1_"))|> 
  mutate(OR= round(exp(beta), 2),
         CI_lo = round(exp(beta- 1.96*beta.std.err), 2),
         CI_hi = round(exp(beta+ 1.96*beta.std.err), 2),
         lt7= paste0(OR, " (",CI_lo, "-",CI_hi,"), p=",lrt.pvalue))|>
  dplyr::select(variant, lt7),
DBGWAS_lt7_sig |> 
  mutate(OR= round(exp(beta), 2),
         CI_lo = round(exp(beta- 1.96*beta.std.err), 2),
         CI_hi = round(exp(beta+ 1.96*beta.std.err), 2),
         lt7= paste0(OR, " (",CI_lo, "-",CI_hi,"), p=",lrt.pvalue))|>
  dplyr::select(variant, lt7),
PanGWAS_lt7_sig |> 
  mutate(OR= round(exp(beta), 2),
         CI_lo = round(exp(beta- 1.96*beta.std.err), 2),
         CI_hi = round(exp(beta+ 1.96*beta.std.err), 2),
         lt7= paste0(OR, " (",CI_lo, "-",CI_hi,"), p=",lrt.pvalue))|>
  dplyr::select(variant, lt7))

final_df_lt7
```

# Plot the proportion  of significant hits across treshold weeks
```{r}
# Load SNP distribution across samples
sig_SNPs <- read.delim("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Pyseer Results/Nextflow_pipeline_EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC/15.1.Main_analysis/Sig_SNP.txt")
sig_SNPs_df <- sig_SNPs  |> 
  dplyr::select(- X.CHROM, -ID, -QUAL, -FILTER, -INFO, -FORMAT)|>
  mutate(across(4:1543, ~ ifelse(grepl("1/1", .), 1, 0)))|>
  mutate(Sum = rowSums(across(4:1543), na.rm = TRUE),
         Proportion = round(Sum / 1540, 3))|>
  mutate(across(4:1543, ~ ifelse(grepl("1", .), "present", "absent")))|>
  mutate(MUT= paste0(REF, POS, ALT), .before = 1)|> 
  dplyr::select(-POS, -REF, -ALT)
df_t <- as.data.frame(t(sig_SNPs_df[,-1]))
colnames(df_t) <- sig_SNPs_df[[1]]
df_t <- df_t|>
  mutate(samples = rownames(df_t))

# Load Unitig distribution across samples
Sig_Unitig <- read.delim("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Pyseer Results/Nextflow_pipeline_EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC/15.1.Main_analysis/Sig_Unitig.txt", sep=" ", header=F)|>
  dplyr::select(-V2)
Sig_Unitig[] <- lapply(Sig_Unitig, function(x) gsub(":1", "", x)) 
order_unitigs <- c("ATCTTTTAAAATAGAAACTGTTATTTTTTGCA", "TTGTTGATCATTATGTCCTAGACCTAAAGCATGTCCTAA", "AATATTTCGTTTAACAAAAAAAATACTTTGCGAGGTCTCCATGCAGA", "AGCGACGTTTATGAATGCAGTTTCTAAAGGAAAAAAA", "TTTATGAATGCAGTTTCTAAAGGAAAAAAAACTATTGTGG", "TGTAGATATTGAAAGGTTACAAAATGTAGTCTATGAGGG", "TCGGTTCGAATGTGGGATAACACATTCGTCCAC", "GACGAATGTGTTATCCCACATTCGAACCGACCTGTT", "AAAAATGTTTGAATTAGGTAGTAATATTGACA", "TGATAATAGTGGAGAAATTTGTGATAATTTATCTCA", "AAATTATCACAAATTTCTCCACTATTATCAGTGGATCCATCAT", "TTTAGAAACTGCATTCATAAACGTCGCTGGGCCGCCATGTGTGAT" )
Sig_Unitig <- Sig_Unitig |>
  filter(V1 %in% order_unitigs) |>
  mutate(V1 = factor(V1, levels = order_unitigs)) |>
  arrange(V1)

Unitig_sig_t <- df_t|> dplyr::select(samples)
for(i in 1:nrow(Sig_Unitig)){
  present_samples <- as.vector(unlist(Sig_Unitig[i, -1]))
  new_var <- ifelse(Unitig_sig_t$samples %in% present_samples, "present", "absent")
  Unitig_sig_t[[paste0("Unitig_", i)]] <- new_var
}
Unitig_sig_t <- Unitig_sig_t[,-1]
Unitig_sig_t <- Unitig_sig_t|>
  mutate(samples = rownames(Unitig_sig_t))


# Load Gene distribution across samples
gene_presence_absence <- read.table("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Pyseer Results/Nextflow_pipeline_EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC/15.1.Main_analysis/gene_presence_absence.Rtab", header=T)
gene_sig <- gene_presence_absence |> 
  filter(Gene %in% c("arnC", "group_1981"))
gene_sig_Sum_prop <- gene_sig|>
  mutate(Sum = rowSums(across(2:ncol(gene_sig)), na.rm = TRUE),
         Proportion = round(Sum / (ncol(gene_sig)-1), 3))|>
  dplyr::select(Gene, Sum, Proportion)
gene_sig_Sum_prop
gene_sig <- gene_sig |>
  mutate(across(2:1541, ~ ifelse(grepl("1", .), "present", "absent")))
gene_sig_t <- as.data.frame(t(gene_sig[,-1])) 
colnames(gene_sig_t) <- gene_sig[[1]] 
gene_sig_t <- gene_sig_t|>
  mutate(samples = rownames(gene_sig_t))

# Load phenotypes
setwd("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Typing/EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC")
phenotypes <- read.table("phenotypes.txt", header=T)

# Join 
df_variant_pheno <- left_join(left_join(left_join(phenotypes, gene_sig_t), Unitig_sig_t), df_t)|>
  filter(! is.na(arnC)) |> 
  mutate(lt7 = ifelse(continuous<=7, "EOD",  "LOD/VLOD"), 
         lt14 = ifelse(continuous<=14, "pre14",  "post14"), 
         lt14 = factor(lt14, levels=c( "pre14",  "post14")), 
         lt30 = ifelse(continuous<=30, "pre30",  "post30"), 
         lt60 = ifelse(continuous<=60, "pre60",  "post60"))%>%
  mutate(week = (continuous - 1) %/% 7 + 1)  %>%
  mutate(week = ifelse(week ==0, 1, week)) %>%
  mutate(week4 = ifelse(week>=4, ">=4", week), 
         week4 = factor(week4, levels=c( "1",  "2","3",  ">=4")))


library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(rlang)

plot_stacked_bar_prop <- function(df, group_var, fill_palette = "Set2", x_var = week4, plot_title = NULL) {
  # Tidy select with {{}}: evaluate 'group_var' and 'x_var' as arguments
  group_var <- enquo(group_var)
  x_var <- enquo(x_var)
  
  # Summarise for percent labels
  df_sum <- df %>%
    group_by(!!x_var, !!group_var) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop_last") %>%
    mutate(
      total = sum(n),
      prop = n / total,
      lab = paste0(sprintf("%.0f", prop * 100), "%")
    ) %>%
    ungroup()

  df_sum_total <- df_sum %>%
    group_by(!!x_var) %>%
    summarise(total = unique(total), .groups = "drop")
  
  # Use rlang::as_name to convert group_var to string for aes_string
  group_var_str <- rlang::as_name(group_var)
  x_var_str <- rlang::as_name(x_var)
  
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = !!x_var, fill = !!group_var)) + 
    geom_bar(position = "fill", stat = "count") +
    labs(
      x = as.character(x_var_str),
      y = "Proportion"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    guides(fill = "none") +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = fill_palette) +
    geom_text(
      data = df_sum,
      aes(
        x = !!x_var,
        y = prop,
        label = lab,
        group = !!group_var
      ),
      position = position_fill(vjust = 0.5),
      size = 5,
      color = "white"
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = df_sum_total,
      aes(
        x = !!x_var,
        y = 1.05, # above the bar
        label = paste0("n=", total)
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 5,
      vjust = 0
    )
  
  if (!is.null(plot_title)) {
    p <- p + ggtitle(plot_title)
  }
  
  p
}
```
